explanation: Compared against OEIS A255916 (Zhi-Wei Sun): a(n) = number of ways to write n as G_7(k) + P_8(x) + P_9(y) with k ∈ ℤ generalized heptagonal k(5k−3)/2, x, y ≥ 0; conjecture (i) a(n) > 0 for all n. The Lean `a` sums the indicator over k ∈ [−(n+1), n+1] and x, y ∈ [0, n], which covers every possible solution (|G_7(k)| ≥ |k|, P_m(x) ≥ x). generalizedPolygonalNumber 7 k = (5k²−3k)/2 and polygonalNumber m x = (m−2)x(x−1)/2 + x match the standard formulas; since k ↦ G_7(k) is injective on ℤ, counting triples equals counting representations, and the test values a(0..4) = 1,3,3,1,1 agree with the OEIS data. The statement 0 < a n for all n is exactly the conjecture. Faithful.
